summary: Evaluates two quadratic spring functions at a given input a2 on a double-coefficient object: result0 = a*x^2 + b*x + c for the force set (c=+0x4, b=+0xC, a=+0x14) and the same shape for the derivative set (c=+0x1C, b=+0x24, a=+0x2C), writing the force result to +0x34 and the derivative result to +0x3C. Part of the suspension spring model, evaluated per frame on the frame path and called by SolverDispatch (0043b930) and sub_43BC20 (0043bc20).

local_names.a2: input value at which both quadratic functions are evaluated
local_names.v0: computed force result written to this+0x34
local_names.v1: computed derivative result written to this+0x3C

operations.description: Force polynomial evaluated at a2: force = a2 * this+0x14 * a2 + a2 * this+0xC + this+0x4 (quadratic coefficient from +0x14, linear from +0xC, constant from +0x4)
Store the evaluated force polynomial into this+0x34 (the computed force result)
Derivative polynomial evaluated at a2: derivative = a2 * this+0x2C * a2 + a2 * this+0x24 + this+0x1C (quadratic coefficient from +0x2C, linear from +0x24, constant from +0x1C)
Store the evaluated derivative polynomial into this+0x3C (the computed derivative result)
Function returns void; both results are side effects written to the this object
Invoked on the frame path by SolverDispatch (0043b930) and by sub_43BC20 (0043bc20) to obtain spring force and damping at a given travel input
